Node_4 is not a distribution outlier but a leakage+noise fault: collector_tag_score has MI 1.0002 on node_4 vs <=0.0041 on peers, and after excluding it node_4's suspected_noise_rate (0.2111) and high_conf_conflict_rate (0.1296) more than 4x peers with mean_self_confidence collapsing to 0.4496. Node_1's mild elevation (0.1086 noise rate) is explained by legitimate Non-IID rare-class concentration (Analysis/Backdoor/Shellcode/Worms = 100% node_1), so node_1 and node_2 are left untouched.
